answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 155316 Country: India Title: Confusing in taking bath, repeating many times fardh of ghusl. It takes up to 2 hours. Suggest something to solve this problem. Question: Confusing in taking bath, repeating many times fardh of ghusl. It takes up to 2 hours. Suggest something to solve this problem. Answer ID: 155316 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 89/62/SN=2/1439) For ghusl of janabat (impurity) the obligatory acts are: gargling well, sending water in the nose and pouring water over the whole body. These acts may be carried out within fifteen minutes, even in less than it. Thus you should try to wind up your ghusl within ten to fifteen minutes. Yet, if you have some doubt and waswasah then you must not pay any attention towards it. If you do ghusl in this way for some days then in-shaAllah you won’t be affected by waswasah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
